heading.title: First Division · Part IX · Suits Relating to Miscellaneous Matters

article.title: One year.
article.content:
Article97One year.

The Schedule  ·  First Division—Suits · Part IX—Suits Relating to Miscellaneous Matters
To enforce a right of pre-emption whether the right is founded on law or general usage or on special contract.
Period of limitationOne year.

Time from which period begins to runWhen the purchaser take under the sale sought to be impeached, physical possession of the whole or part of the property sold, or, where the subject matter of the sale does not admit of physical possession of the whole or part of the property, when the instrument of sale is registered.
